semantics.transition: At every rising edge: if load is 1, counter becomes data; else if counter is nonzero, counter becomes counter minus 1; else counter stays zero.
semantics.load_priority: Loading overrides countdown, including while counting and at zero. Consecutive load cycles reload each edge.
semantics.output: tc is combinationally true exactly when the current counter is zero; no extra output register or clock latency.
semantics.duration: After loading N, tc asserts after N subsequent rising edges with load=0; loading zero asserts tc immediately after that edge.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No initialization specified; state and tc are unspecified before a known load.
semantics.between_edges: Input changes do not alter counter or tc until a rising edge.

numeric.arithmetic: Exact subtraction of one only for nonzero counter; saturate at zero, no underflow wrap.

verification.oracle: Independent integer remaining-cycle model observing only ports, initialized by a load; expected tc equals remaining==0.
directed: load one and check exact expiration edge
verification.coverage: Exhaustively load all 1024 data values and count each to zero, then check zero remains held; deterministic mixed load/decrement stimulus.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite shell timeouts for compile and simulation, plus testbench watchdog.
verification.scope: No official tests, reference RTL, synthesis or board access.

specification_ambiguities.text: The module should implement a single D flip-flop.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: A literal one-bit flip-flop cannot store the specified 10-bit duration. Interpret as one clocked 10-bit counter register; prioritize the explicit timer transition and interface requirements.
